newsitem.title: SPAIN: Ecuador to sell 35 pct Emetel in H2 - official.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to sell 35 pct Emetel in H2 - official.

text.p: Ecuador plans to sell a 35 percent of state telephone group Emetel in the second half of the year, central bank general manager Fidel Jaramillo said on Tuesday.

"Emetel was originally scheduled for the second quarter...It has to be postponed to the second half of the year. But it's one of the priorities," Jaramillo said at a news conference at the annual meeting of the Inter-American Development Bank.
"It will be one of the first major sales of assets," he added.

The sale was delayed by political upheavel in February when an interim governmnet replaced President Abdala Bucaram, who was removed from the presidency as corruption and drastic price increases sparked mass protests.
